customer_name: Chery Auto Finance (奇瑞汽车金融)
business_problem: Chery Auto Finance needed to raise risk-control automation fast enough to match 50% business growth, support more complex multi-brand lending, and manage both customer and dealer risk without expanding approval headcount.
solution_summary: Tencent Cloud helped Chery Auto Finance build a risk middle platform around Tencent Decision Platform so risk control could run as a shared digital service. The implementation combines data scheduling, model deployment and optimization, and daily risk operations in one stack that supports the full lending lifecycle. Customer and dealer application data flow through the shared layer, where model-driven decision logic produces agile tools for partners, regional centers, business units, and management. The platform supports Chery's A-card, B-card, and C-card strategies while automating dealer risk management. By joining mature big-data techniques with model governance and operational workflows, the system lets Chery keep pace with rapid business growth, raise approval automation, and preserve asset quality across higher-volume, higher-risk lending.

solution_components.name: Tencent Decision Platform
solution_components.role: Hosts and executes model-driven decision logic for Chery's risk-control workflows.

solution_components.name: risk middle platform
solution_components.role: Centralizes lifecycle risk operations so customer and dealer risk management can run through one shared service layer.

solution_components.name: data scheduling management
solution_components.role: Coordinates the ingestion and movement of operational and risk data used by the platform.

solution_components.name: model deployment and optimization management
solution_components.role: Publishes, tunes, and governs the models and strategies used in automated risk decisions.

solution_components.name: risk daily management
solution_components.role: Provides operational tools for ongoing monitoring and day-to-day risk control work.

data_flow: Customer and dealer business data enters the shared data scheduling layer, where Tencent Decision Platform applies risk models and strategies managed through the deployment and optimization layer. The resulting decisions feed approval workflows, customer A/B/C card operations, dealer risk management, and daily monitoring used by Chery's partners, regional centers, business departments, and management teams.
business_outcome: Chery Auto Finance raised approval automation, handled 50% business growth without adding approval staff, preserved bad-loan performance despite a riskier business mix, and improved dealer risk-management efficiency through a centralized digital risk stack.
